propositions: [operator-attested] evidence contract currently demands provenance of the attestation event (change id / vote / timestamp) but not the measurement itself (environment, principal, privilege level), leaving two escape paths: wrong environment (measurements from account 579718921998 attested for work targeting 896586841071) and privilege masking (evidence taken under bedrock:* that cannot fail in production under scoped bedrock:InvokeModel).

The mechanism must force measurement context (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) into the record as required text fields on a continuation line under [operator-attested] checkboxes, making contradictions detectable by repo-grounded gates.

A deterministic check (det_measurement_provenance.py) must validate presence and shape of the four provenance fields (non-placeholder values, enum membership for privilege_posture and instrument) without judging correctness, flagging incomplete declarations as advisory.

An AGENT-tier criterion (project.measurement-provenance) with tool access (execution_mode: agentic) must compare declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors and flag authorization claims validated under simulation or static analysis even when privilege_posture is production-equivalent.

The four-field syntax is pinned (environment=<value>; principal=<value>; privilege_posture=<production-equivalent|broader|narrower>; instrument=<live-call|simulation|static-analysis> — <justification>) and must bind to the nearest preceding [operator-attested] checkbox item via indentation and case-insensitive provenance: prefix.

Existing [operator-attested] criteria predating this contract amendment ship advisory coaching without blocking, grandfathering pre-contract tickets, while new criteria must declare full provenance to avoid advisory flag.
